# 🐸 ShneinePack

![Pack Icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1bcb9d54b5630b797c0b5cda2b84d65eef5cd107.jpeg)

---
***Created for the vibes. Shneine fa, watafa!***

**Pepe Shneine** is the ultimate sound overhaul for your Minecraft world. Tired of the same old "Hrmmm" from your villagers? This resource pack replaces their boring ambient sounds with the viral **"Pepe Shneine Fa Watafa"** ad-libs and memes.

## ✨ Features

* **Vibe Check:** Every villager in your world now speaks the language of 2025.
* **"POMYTSYA SHNEINE!":** Trading has never been this... intense. Hear the iconic catchphrase every time a deal goes through.
* **Watafa Moments:** Hear the legendary "Watafa" whenever a villager refuses a trade or takes a hit.
* **Prank Ready:** The perfect lightweight pack to slip into your friend's resource folder for an unforgettable surprise.

## 🛠 Tech Details

* **Version:** 1.21.1 (Uses `pack_format: 34`, compatible with modern Minecraft versions).
* **Complete Overhaul:** Replaces `entity.villager.ambient`, `entity.villager.no`, `entity.villager.yes`, `entity.villager.trade`, and `entity.villager.death`.
* **Zero Lag:** No scripts or heavy code—just high-quality `.ogg` files optimized for performance.

## 📥 Installation Guide

1. Download the **ShneinePack.zip** file.
2. Open Minecraft and go to **Options** -> **Resource Packs**.
3. Click **Open Pack Folder**.
4. Drop the `.zip` file into the folder.
5. Activate the pack in the menu and enjoy the concert!
